lines.zh: 我身上的鳞是下界的颜色。
lines.en: My scales carry Nether colors.
I walk the dark red stone.
Scorch marks on my wings.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，沿岩脊移动。
lines.en: Low along the ridge.

lines.zh: 下界配色的鳞，踩得很稳。
lines.en: Nether-colored scales land firm.
No detour. Straight at you.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴拖在岩浆边缘。
lines.en: My tail drags near the lava.
I like the heat here.

lines.zh: 我从龙之手遗迹被带到这里。
lines.en: Taken from the Dragon's Hand to here.
My scales click as I walk.
Closing toward you.

lines.zh: 地面的裂缝在我脚下扩大。
lines.en: Cracks widen under my feet.

lines.zh: 我站着，喉咙里发着暗光。
lines.en: I stand. Dark light glows in my throat.
Void colors on my hide.

lines.zh: 我翅膀一展，热气往外推。
lines.en: Wings out. The heat pushes away.
I remember the ruins. Cold there.

lines.zh: 下界的蛋孵出来的，就是我。
lines.en: A Nether egg hatched me.
I sharpen my claws in a crevice.

lines.zh: 我一动，影子就在墙上爬。
lines.en: When I move, my shadow crawls the wall.

lines.zh: 我的鳞吸着这里的热气。
lines.en: My scales soak up the heat.
I lower my head and smell the lava.
A layer of soot on my scales.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩尾巴，赶走热气。
lines.en: A tail flick to clear the heat.
I turn my head slowly to look behind.
I dig my claws into the crack.
Deciding which side to hit first.

lines.zh: 你身上是青草和雨的味道。
lines.en: You smell of grass and rain.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻，你是从上面来的。
lines.en: I sniff; you came from above.

lines.zh: 你站得很稳，可惜地方不对。
lines.en: Steady stance. Wrong place.
My eyes are dark red.
Weapon up. Sweaty hands.

lines.zh: 我这样看着你，不算友好。
lines.en: This look isn't friendly.
My eyes glow red in the dark.

lines.zh: 我在你身后也能看见你。
lines.en: I can see you even from behind.
Your breathing is loud here.

lines.zh: 我身上的颜色，你见过吗？
lines.en: Seen these colors before?
This rock is mine.

lines.zh: 你退到岩壁那边，我不动。
lines.en: Go to the wall. I won't move.
A scale fell off me.
Half a step back. The floor cracked.

lines.zh: 这一下，烟灰都抖下来了。
lines.en: That shook the soot off me.
My wings snapped in.
You didn't break through.
I growl. Fire in my throat.
I'll forget this quickly.
The wound's edge smells of scorch.
Ash got between my scales.
You're still standing. Good.
Meat smell. Through the rock.

lines.zh: 你那点东西不够我一口。
lines.en: Not enough for one bite.
Do not feed me by hand; I bite.
Nothing cooked. Blood still hot.

lines.zh: 下界的果子上有硫磺味。
lines.en: Nether fruit smells of sulfur.

lines.zh: 这东西有下界的味道吗？没有。
lines.en: Does this smell of the Nether? No.
On the ground. You step back.

lines.zh: 我吃东西的时候会看着你。
lines.en: I'll watch you while I eat.
That only delays me.
Still reaching out. Bold.
You hit hard scales.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，尾巴卷起灰。
lines.en: Half a step back. My tail lifts ash.
I hatched down in the Nether.

lines.zh: 这一下，你手上留了烟灰。
lines.en: Now there's soot on your hand.

lines.zh: 我让你过去，但只是这一次。
lines.en: I let you pass. Once.
The crack widened after that.
Heavier than I expected.
My wing grazed your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我们离得太近，你的武器伸不开。
lines.en: This close, your weapon can't swing.
Your boot pins my tail tip.
I hatched from an egg.

lines.zh: 龙之手的遗迹里，没有伴侣。
lines.en: In the Dragon's Hand ruins, no mates.
Stand back. My scales are sharp.
My kind knows eggs and fire.
To come close, you'd have to beat me.

lines.zh: 我的味道很重，你受不住。
lines.en: My scent is strong. You couldn't bear it.
Back away. Leave my wings.
This rock is enough for one.
This place keeps no guests.
I turn my head to the lava.
I take it. Hot.
It smokes in my claw.
I sniff it. Iron.
I take these pieces too.

lines.zh: 我把它按进土里，弄灭了。
lines.en: I press it into the soil. Out.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西，我一爪按住。
lines.en: A claw pins what you dropped.

lines.zh: 鳞缝里的石子都比它重。
lines.en: Pebbles between my scales weigh more.
It softens in my mouth.
I lift it and check.
Useless. Dropped it.
You've walked onto my rock.
My pupils narrow to slits.

lines.zh: 岩浆的光照出你的位置。
lines.en: Lava light shows where you are.
Head low. Shoulders up.

lines.zh: 诡异的下界，白气也能看见。
lines.en: In the warped Nether, even white breath shows.

lines.zh: 你背后是岩壁，前面是我。
lines.en: Rock behind you, me in front.
Fire is rising in my throat.
I've taken this angle.

lines.zh: 你的脚印在岩粉上很清楚。
lines.en: Your prints show clearly in the rock dust.
The egg taught me patience.

lines.zh: 这片荒地只有你的味道。
lines.en: This waste holds only your scent.
I move first. Best you watch.
I'm already walking at you.
No further. Stand.
I come along the rock wall.
You retreat. I follow the heat.
My scales are drawing tight.
That won't cut through this.

lines.zh: 我翅膀一张，热气就散开。
lines.en: Wings out. The heat spreads.

lines.zh: 你的影子在地上，我看见了。
lines.en: Your shadow. I see it.

lines.zh: 这层岩很薄，我一撞就破。
lines.en: Thin rock. One hit and it breaks.

lines.zh: 我在下界孵出来，鳞是紫的。
lines.en: Hatched in the Nether, my scales are purple.
Only I know these paths.

lines.zh: 我贴着岩壁，跟在你后面。
lines.en: I hug the rock wall behind you.
One block nearer to me now.

lines.zh: 我的爪子已经抓进岩里。
lines.en: Claws dug into the rock.

lines.zh: 你听见热气的声音了吗？
lines.en: Hear the heat?
The heat rises. Now.
Turning back won't help.

lines.zh: 我扑过去，爪子压在你肩上。
lines.en: I lunge. Claws on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我一爪划在你的护腿上。
lines.en: One claw rakes across your greaves.

lines.zh: 一口火喷出来，岩面发黑。
lines.en: A burst of fire. The rock blackens.
My tail tip cracks across your ribs.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得你退了很远。
lines.en: That knocked you far back.
Your shield edge slipped. I didn't stop.
I pin you. Claws stay.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀扇起来，灰全飞了。
lines.en: Wings beat. Ash everywhere.

lines.zh: 这一下，我也掉了一小片鳞。
lines.en: That cost me a scale too.

lines.zh: 你退进烟里，我原地站着。
lines.en: You fade into smoke. I stay put.

lines.zh: 我的鳞在你刀上留下白痕。
lines.en: Your blade left a white streak on my scales.

lines.zh: 这一声很闷，只有你自己听见。
lines.en: A dull sound only you heard.
My mouth opens again.
Ash is settling slowly.
I came out of a Nether egg.

lines.zh: 这具身体的颜色是下界给的。
lines.en: The Nether gave this body its colors.
I saw lava when I broke the shell.
I landed on black rock.

lines.zh: 翅膀还湿，但很快就干了。
lines.en: Wings wet. They dried fast.

lines.zh: 我抬头，这里的空气有烟。
lines.en: I look up. Smoke in the air.

lines.zh: 我在遗迹里等了很多年。
lines.en: I waited years in the ruins.
I spread my wings. Heat follows.
No other dragon on this rock.
My first call was rough.
Fire comes from my throat.
I've chosen this place.

lines.zh: 有人把蛋带到这片岩地。
lines.en: Someone carried my egg to this rock.
I stood a while in the ash.
You didn't see me come in.
I rise slowly. Scales click.
Fire doesn't frighten me. Scales glow red.
Fell. A wing folded wrong.
Water's rare here. And heavy.
The blast pushed me into the rock.
Something pierced my wing.
That power goes around scales.
Long without food. Wings heavy.

lines.zh: 雷打在岩上，我全身一麻。
lines.en: Lightning on the rock. Numb everywhere.
Falling. It was already deep.
